note: descriptor nesting is not limited by maxDepth, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.nestingAndCountsStopAtTheirLimits
a descriptor item count is not checked against maxItems, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.nestingAndCountsStopAtTheirLimits
D-list-depth: list nesting unbounded, so lists nested past maxDepth read instead of throwing, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.listsStopAtMaxDepth
D-comp-skip: a comp value skips 4 bytes instead of 8, so later items misread, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.skippedValuesKeepTheReaderAligned
D-text-nul: a TEXT value keeps its trailing NUL, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.textDropsOnlyItsTrailingNul
D-type-skip: a type or GlbC value skips only its id, not its display name, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.skippedValuesKeepTheReaderAligned
D-tdta-skip: a tdta or alis value reads its length but not its bytes, caught by PSDDescriptorTests.skippedValuesKeepTheReaderAligned
